description: Modular voice communications hooks for Spark Intelligence Builder.

onboarding.role: Speech I/O runtime for transcribing inbound audio and synthesizing spoken replies for Spark.
limitations: Installing this chip does not activate voice by itself; the host Spark runtime must approve and route voice.
Provider keys and voice ids must come from local config or hook payloads, not the public repo.
Quality depends on STT/TTS provider health and channel delivery behavior.
Voice delivery still inherits Telegram and provider-specific media constraints.
